A NOTE FROM THE SPHERE

“We wanted
to create a space
to simply be.”

There are so many spaces created for women to work harder, look better, achieve more and become more.

We wanted to create something different. A space to pause. A space to connect. A space to simply be.

The Sphere was created for the woman behind all the roles she carries.

Come as you are.
Stay for what you discover.

The Sphere

WELLNESS IN YOUR INBOX

Stay close.

Early word on gatherings, gentle reminders to pause, and the occasional note from the circle. Sent rarely. Never shared.

Crafted calm for the modern woman.

Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
